name: CCPP Electrical Systems Technology Diploma (D35130PB)
sourceWorkbook: RCCC catalog 2026–27 (program 35130 and course pages), Self-Service course schedule Fall 2026 – Summer 2027, 2026–27 academic calendar, NCAEC apprenticeship handbook — compiled 2026-10-20
note: The diploma's 40 credits spread over five terms for Career & College Promise high-school students (a lighter load): COM 231 fixed in place of the open elective, CST 131 and EGR 125 in a fifth term. Taught to the A.L. Brown HS cohort (10 seats); the college publishes sections there only for ELC 111 and CST 131, so days and times are not yet on record. The college's own program-structure workbook replaces these sessions when it arrives.
weeklyHoursNote: Term hours per student are the catalog's weekly contact hours × 16 (the 16-week basis), whatever the term's length: the sessions carry them, the posted days, times and rooms place them. Hours and credits are the catalog's; sessions are the college's day sections; clinical hours are zero in every course.
